metadata.title: The Google & Alphabet Mega-Ecosystem Atlas (10,000+ Verified Websites)
metadata.author: Nandhakumar Murugan (Google Student Ambassador)
metadata.description: The definitive 10,000+ directory of all official Google and Alphabet websites, products, developer APIs, student programs, country portals, and AI research breakthroughs.

entries.name: NotebookLM
entries.description: AI-powered personalized research assistant and source-grounded note-taking notebook featuring Audio Overview podcasts.

entries.name: Google Labs Portal
entries.description: Google's public incubator for breakthrough generative AI experiments, prototypes, and creative AI tools.

entries.name: Google Illuminate
entries.description: AI experiment that transforms complex scientific papers into engaging audio discussions between AI voices.

entries.name: AI Test Kitchen (MusicFX, ImageFX, TextFX)
entries.description: Interactive laboratory to experience, test, and give feedback on cutting-edge generative audio, image, and text models.

entries.name: Google AI Studio
entries.description: Web-based prototyping environment for developers to experiment with Gemini models, system instructions, structured output, and API key generation.

entries.name: Google DeepMind
entries.description: World-leading artificial intelligence research laboratory creating breakthroughs from AlphaFold to Gemini, Gemma, and AGI foundations.

entries.name: Gemini Web Portal
entries.description: Direct conversational interface for Google's multimodal Gemini AI assistant, supporting text, image, code, audio, and Advanced workspace extensions.

entries.name: Google AI Research Hub
entries.description: Flagship gateway for Google's research publications, responsible AI principles, breakthrough models, and open science.

entries.name: Google AI Blog / Research Blog
entries.description: In-depth technical articles, algorithmic breakthroughs, model announcements, and peer-reviewed computer science literature.

entries.name: Gemma Open Models Hub
entries.description: Google's state-of-the-art family of lightweight, open-weight models built from the same research and technology used for Gemini.

entries.name: Kaggle Data Science Community
entries.description: The world's largest data science community with ML competitions, open datasets, free GPU/TPU notebooks, and community rankings.

entries.name: TensorFlow Framework
entries.description: End-to-end open source machine learning platform for training, deployment, mobile (Lite), and browser execution (JS).

entries.name: JAX (Google Research)
entries.description: Autograd and XLA for high-performance machine learning research in Python, powering state-of-the-art LLM training.

entries.name: Keras Multi-Backend Library
entries.description: High-level deep learning API designed for human beings, running seamlessly on JAX, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.

entries.name: Vertex AI (Google Cloud)
entries.description: Fully managed unified AI platform on Google Cloud for training, tuning, deploying, and monitoring custom GenAI and predictive ML models.

entries.name: Google Colab
entries.description: Interactive cloud-hosted Jupyter notebook service with free access to Google Cloud GPUs, TPUs, and AI coding assistants.

entries.name: MediaPipe (Google AI Edge)
entries.description: Cross-platform, customizable ML solutions for live and streaming media (face mesh, pose estimation, hand tracking, object detection).

entries.name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database
entries.description: Database predicting 3D structures for over 200 million proteins, revolutionizing structural biology and drug discovery.

entries.name: AlphaFold Server (AlphaFold 3)
entries.description: Interactive AlphaFold 3 molecular modeling platform allowing global scientists to model DNA, RNA, ligands, and protein complexes for free.

entries.name: AlphaProteo Generative Biology
entries.description: AI system designing novel protein binders to accelerate drug design and virus neutralization.

entries.name: AlphaProof & AlphaGeometry 2
entries.description: Formal mathematical reasoning AI capable of solving International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) problems at silver medal level.

entries.name: GraphCast AI Weather Forecasting
entries.description: Global 10-day weather forecasting model trained on historical data with supercomputer accuracy in seconds.

entries.name: SIMA (Generalist AI Agent for 3D Worlds)
entries.description: Scalable Instructable Multiworld Agent that follows natural language instructions to play 3D video games.

entries.name: Genie 2 Foundation World Model
entries.description: Large-scale foundation world model generating playable, interactive 3D virtual environments from a single prompt.

entries.name: GameNGen Real-Time Neural Game Engine
entries.description: First neural game engine running complex games like DOOM in real time via generative diffusion.

entries.name: SynthID Watermarking
entries.description: State-of-the-art technology for watermarking and identifying AI-generated content (images, audio, text, video) directly into digital pixels and tokens.

entries.name: Google DeepMind Project Astra
entries.description: Next-generation universal real-time multimodal AI agent capable of seeing, hearing, remembering, and acting in the physical world.

entries.name: People + AI Research (PAIR)
entries.description: Multidisciplinary team studying and shaping the human side of AI through research, design guidelines, and interactive open source tools.

entries.name: TensorBoard
entries.description: Visualization suite for machine learning experimentation, metric tracking, model graph inspection, and embedding projection.

entries.name: Google Dataset Search
entries.description: Specialized search engine to discover scientific, economic, and academic datasets online.

entries.name: Google Data Commons
entries.description: Open knowledge graph combining public datasets from UN, CDC, World Bank, and US Census.

entries.name: Google Quantum AI Lab
entries.description: Pioneering superconducting quantum processors (Sycamore) and Cirq open-source quantum programming.

entries.name: Cirq Quantum Framework
entries.description: Python framework for writing, manipulating, and optimizing quantum circuits for NISQ computers.

entries.name: Teachable Machine
entries.description: Fast, easy web-based tool for teaching machine learning models to recognize images, sounds, and poses without coding.

entries.name: Quick, Draw! Neural Game
entries.description: World's largest neural network doodling game, gathering over 1 billion drawings to train neural vision models.

entries.name: AutoDraw
entries.description: Fast drawing tool pairing machine learning with artist illustrations to help anyone sketch quickly.

entries.name: Experiments with Google
entries.description: Showcase of creative coder experiments across AI, WebXR, Chrome, Android, and voice computing.

entries.name: Google Semantris
entries.description: Word association game powered by semantic machine learning neural embeddings.

entries.name: Google Shadow Art
entries.description: AI shadow puppet game utilizing TensorFlow.js and camera recognition.

entries.name: Visualizing High-Dimensional Space (Embedding Projector)
entries.description: Interactive web tool to explore PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP high-dimensional embeddings in 3D.

entries.name: Google DeepMind Antigravity IDE
entries.description: Next-generation agentic developer IDE and coding environment uniting autonomous multi-agent reasoning with local execution.

entries.name: Gemini 3.8 / 3.7 Frontier Model Hub
entries.description: Official documentation and technical specs for Gemini 3.8 Flash next-gen agentic reasoning and Gemini 3.7 Flash hybrid thinking models.

entries.name: Google Model Armor
entries.description: Enterprise DLP, sensitive data masking, and automated prompt injection defense for LLM pipelines and agent fleets.

entries.name: Google GenAI SDK (Python & TypeScript)
entries.description: Unified, next-generation client library for Google Gemini 3.8, 3.7, 2.0, Imagen 3, and Vertex AI.

entries.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Google Ecosystem
entries.description: Universal open protocol connecting Gemini Spark cloud reasoning with local IDEs, developer tools, and enterprise datasources.

entries.name: Gemini Antigravity Bridge
entries.description: Production-grade MCP server connecting Google Gemini Spark to local DeepMind Antigravity with 23 tools and zero-latency execution.

entries.name: AgentShield: Zero-Trust Multi-Agent Guardrails
entries.description: Published research architecture enforcing continuous zero-trust verification and runtime guardrails across autonomous agent fleets.
